subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider that sends search queries to Firecrawl's hosted no-auth search tier?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and currently live-proven, but it adds an official provider-selection value and a new anonymous hosted search boundary that repository policy treats as product and security-sensitive.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In Provider
options.body: Accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider after documenting the privacy/upstream-contract boundary and waiting for normal exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl Search Keyed
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep `web_search` on the existing credentialed Firecrawl provider unless a maintainer later sponsors keyless search.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: Ask for this as an external plugin/ClawHub package if maintainers do not want to own the official hosted no-auth provider surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor The Opt-In Provider
recommendation.body: Accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in provider after documenting the privacy/upstream-contract boundary and waiting for normal exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent merged the narrowed Firecrawl keyless scrape/fetch path and the key-free web-search opt-in policy, and previously stated keyless Firecrawl search needs separate sponsorship.
